No `templates/standard/wbs.md` or mission anchor exists in this repo, so I'll build the breakdown directly from the skill's process. Two things surfaced that need a decision before you can hand this out cleanly — flagged below.

## 1. Level 1 — Top Deliverable

**1. Team Billing subsystem** — the capability for a B2B SaaS org to meter usage, calculate charges, store payment methods, generate invoices, and let admins view billing activity for their org.

## 2. Level 2/3 — Product-First Breakdown

| # | Piece | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 1.1 | Billing Engine | component |
| 1.1.1 | Pricing/Plan Rules Model | work package |
| 1.1.2 | Charge Calculation Logic | work package |
| 1.1.3 | Billing Cycle Scheduler | work package |
| 1.2 | Payment-Method Vault | component |
| 1.2.1 | Payment Method Storage | work package |
| 1.2.2 | Payment Method Lifecycle API | work package |
| 1.3 | Invoice Generator | component |
| 1.3.1 | Invoice Document Renderer | work package |
| 1.3.2 | Invoice Numbering & Ledger | work package |
| 1.3.3 | Invoice Delivery | work package |
| 1.4 | Usage-Tracking Service | component |
| 1.4.1 | Usage Event Ingestion | work package |
| 1.4.2 | Usage Aggregation | work package |
| 1.4.3 | Usage Data API | work package |
| 1.5 | Admin Dashboard | component |
| 1.5.1 | Bill/Invoice List View | work package |
| 1.5.2 | Bill Detail View | work package |
| 1.5.3 | Billing Admin Access Control | work package |

## ⚠️ Gap: unassigned scope — payment execution

None of the five named components own "submit the charge to the payment processor and handle the transaction result (success/decline/retry)." The Vault *stores* methods; the Billing Engine *calculates* amounts. Charging is neither. This is either:
- **(a)** in scope for 1.2 (Vault becomes "Payment-Method Vault & Charge Execution"), or
- **(b)** a sixth component ("Payment Processing") that doesn't exist yet in your list.

Per the 100% rule, I'm not silently assigning it — pick (a) or (b) before you divide work, or the charge-execution code will get built twice or not at all.

## 3. Deferred scope — write it down

**Multi-currency support is out of scope for this breakdown.** Team Billing v1 is single-currency only (all of 1.1–1.5 assume one base currency for pricing, storage, and display). Multi-currency is deferred to a later release — no work package here should silently add currency-conversion logic. This line is the record leadership hasn't written down yet.

## Self-check

- **100% rule:** the five named components cover metering → calculation → payment storage → invoicing → viewing. **Exception:** charge execution is an orphaned gap (see above) — not silently covered.
- **No overlaps:** each work package has one parent; cross-component reads are dependencies, not shared ownership.
- **Product-first:** all level-2/3 names are nouns; verbs ("calculate," "render," "ingest") only appear inside deliverable/acceptance descriptions, not as piece names.
- **Deferred scope:** multi-currency now has a written line instead of living only in someone's memory.
- **Dictionary:** complete for all 19 pieces; Owner column left blank for your team to fill in when assigning.

## Next steps
1. Decide the charge-execution gap (fold into 1.2 or add a 1.6 Payment Processing component) — this changes ownership and can't be split fairly until resolved.
2. Assign owners into the blank column; work packages (1.1.1–1.5.3) are the right grain for individual ownership.
3. Hand off to `organizing-project-folders` to turn this numbering into your repo/folder structure, and to `plan.md`/stage contracts per leaf if any of this work will be delegated to another agent session.
